title: mcmt apply report
description: Writer output. Exists because editplan.unwritten only covers refusals the BACKEND made; refusals the WRITER makes (stale node, placeholder residue, external .mcc, unknown compression, list homogeneity failure) previously had no exit and would have been reported only to stderr. Anything not written must be enumerated somewhere machine-readable, or 'it silently did nothing' becomes indistinguishable from success.

outcome.description: aborted: refused before touching anything. rolled_back: a failure occurred mid-write and every protected file was restored from the backup set.

backup.description: Null only when outcome is dry_run or aborted-before-backup. Any other null here is a bug: no write is permitted without a backup.

directory.description: Absolute path. Printed on every failure path so the user always has a way back.

chunks_copied_verbatim.description: Chunks passed through as their original compressed bytes. Asserting this equals total-minus-touched is the machine-checkable form of the surgical-write rule.

list_promotions.description: How many NBT lists were promoted from all-string to all-compound, forcing every sibling element to be rewritten.

unwritten.description: Writer-side refusals. Same {unit_id, reason, detail} shape as editplan.unwritten, disjoint reason vocabulary.

reason.description: node_changed: expected_encoding no longer matches, i.e. the world moved. placeholder_residue: a [[n]] token survived into a literal value. unsupported_world_structure: pre-1.21 chunk layout (Level.TileEntities or Text1..Text4), which v1 refuses rather than half-supports.
